QuestInfo.name: A Name Never Given
QuestInfo.0: The warrior #p207# had been searching for turned out to be #p502# of #m10004000#.
QuestInfo.1: When I told #p502# of #m10004000# that #b#p207##k was looking for the one who'd saved her life, he seemed to waver for a moment — but then asked me to keep his secret, saying he didn't want her to know who he was. I wonder what I should tell #b#p207##k when I go back to her...  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 47 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I returned to #p207# at #m10001000# and told her what I'd learned about the one who'd saved her life. She seemed a little disappointed, but somehow looked happy all the same.

0.0: So #p207# has been looking for me. Yes, it's true — I'm the one who saved that girl. I've often watched over her from a distance, unseen, just to see that she was safe and well. But I never expected #o700000# to show up like that...
0.1: I... I've done that girl wrong. It's no accident that she suddenly lost her family and fell ill. ... ... That's why I've been atoning for it, in my own way. Do you understand why I'm telling you all this?
0.2: That's right. I don't want that girl to find out about me. I only wish to go on atoning for the rest of my life. I didn't want to have to say this, but... I'm asking you. Tell her you couldn't find me.

yes.0: Good, I'm glad you understand. As for what excuse you give the girl, that's for you to figure out. But I'll trust you to keep my secret.

no.0: I'd like nothing more than to cut you down where you stand... but I'll hold back, for now.

1.0: Oh, you're back! Seeing how long it took, I had a feeling you might have found that warrior. So, how did it go? Did you find out who saved my life? Cough...
1.1: I see. So you found him, but he doesn't want anyone to know who he is. I suppose he must have his own reasons... But I think I got a little too excited. He was a complete stranger to me, and yet somehow, in that moment, I felt the warmth of family — something I'd almost forgotten.
1.2: Hm? He's always worried about me? I see. I wonder why that makes me feel so at ease. I don't think I want to find out any more about him. I have a feeling that when the time is right, I'll get to meet him.
1.3: Thank you so much for helping me with all of this. I'll do my best to feel better. And you can tell him not to worry — I won't be wandering off to dangerous places alone anymore. Well then, see you around! Cough...

npc.0: Whether you go back to that girl or wander off somewhere else, that's none of my concern. But I'll trust you to keep my secret about me.
